'''Jik Noyid''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kadas'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kadas'sa'Nikto]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Around [[3643 BBY]] he resided in the [[Dorn Base]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], teaching his knowledge to others.
